Only during a company trip on which you started tracking, and while it is active: the position of this phone (not of the vehicle), its accuracy, speed, direction and time, about every 10 seconds when moving and every 2 minutes when stopped, plus when tracking started, was interrupted and ended.
Nothing outside a tracked trip, in personal mode, or after you stop tracking or finish the trip. The app never asks for background location and never starts tracking by itself.
People in the company with tracking permission see the trips in their scope, and each access is recorded. Here you see your own sessions.
The company keeps the positions for 90 days after the trip, unless it sets another period between 30 and 365 days; the trip summary follows the trip.

Positions stay protected on this phone until they are sent. If the company revokes this phone or you leave the company, this phone’s copy is erased when the app next connects; a phone without a connection is not erased remotely, and what the company already received follows its retention.
